english.title: Remain on the airport after refusing to be searched - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), following a refusal to

(A)_[be]_
(B)_[have your baggage]_
(C)_[have your vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VRN AND MAKE..),]_

searched by

(D)_[a constable,]_
(E)_[an airport official,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..), remained on the Liverpool John Lennon Airport when asked to leave by

(F)_[him]_
(G)_[her]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(c) and 3(13) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
english.pointstoprove: date and locationhaving refused to be searched OR to have baggage searched OR to have a vehicle searchedand being requested to leave by a constable OR an airport officialremained on the Liverpool John Lennon Airport

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Byelaw 1(3) states that the offence will not be committed by any member of a fire, police or ambulance service acting in the course of their duty or to any emergency vehicle being used by such a person.
